name: webex-action-insights
description: Local-first, read-only Webex conversation insights application.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && tsc -p tsconfig.client.build.json && node scripts/copy-static.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
